description: Xenium Prime human lung cancer FFPE section: four-channel morphology crops of every segmented cell

sample.rule: random.Random(seed).sample(sorted cell IDs, round(fraction x cells))

split.assignment: tiles holding sampled cells, seeded shuffle; a tile joins the first usage (train, val, held-out) whose cumulative target the cells before it have not reached
split.well_rule: the (floor(x / well_um), floor(y / well_um)) neighborhood, nested in one split tile; each crop is one site

smoke.rule: per usage, whole wells of at least two crops in sha256 order of the well ID until the count is reached
